name: Generate the actual piece
criteria: Existing media file with its type and SHA-256 recorded
Generation event declared with tool, responsible actor, and date
Preserve the selected original concept, personality, recognition anchors, and chosen level of realism or stylization

Execution follows the observed method plan for each stage and records method, actual tool, provider/module/access route where applicable, exposed model, prompts, exact input/output files and hashes, known costs, and limitations

Images, edits, voice, animation, video, and lip-sync use verified Higgsfield modules by default, independently of the coordinating assistant; another media provider requires an explicit user choice and unavailable stages stay pending
Exact approved references are actually attached to generation/editing calls and recorded; mentioning paths in a prompt does not attach them
Required character, reference, voice, and video stages have actual evidence; unavailable stages remain pending without silent substitution or omission
Preserve approved identity and references; changing a requested method requires an explicit user decision and recorded replanning
A pilot using approved exact visual/vocal canon precedes batches; preserve historical media and attempts when context changes
Does not approve identity or publish

Current stage-readiness-v1 requires feasible required method stages, exact current attachments/cost/authorization/export/inspection, captured matching start and bounded matching completion evidence; declarations do not dispatch or certify a provider
